fields.name: no
fields.note: wish number text, empty until paid/sealed (lib/account.ts:12)

filtersOrSort: by id from URL ?id=; status in draft|sealed only (others redirect to /app/wishes/<id>)

reads.note: Browser-local today (localStorage 'fw-maker', lib/maker.ts:28-32). Wish has no place for these; server must either add fields (wedding day, opens-now flag, voice seconds) or keep them as draft metadata. 'now' is derived into opensAt at seal.

fields.name: price
fields.note: naira text exactly as code: Moment '₦3,000', Keepsake '₦6,000', Signature '₦12,000', Premiere '₦21,000' (lib/catalog.ts:386-389; these are already the discounted prices)

reads.note: tickets[] in lib/catalog.ts, hardcoded literals = the mock data. Price shown = naira(price) (strings like '₦6,000' -> 6000) plus add-ons x (1-0.4); 'was' = list price. Wire money is integer kobo, so reconciliation converts.

fields.name: price
fields.note: naira text; 'Five more photos' ₦2,000, 'A premium style' ₦4,000; others not used here

reads.note: extras[] lib/catalog.ts:403-414. Used by offer(): 'Five more photos' (when photos exceed cap by <=5, Keepsake/Signature) and 'A premium style' (Keepsake with Premium style). Also KEEPSAKE_EXTRAS_CEILING '₦7,500' (maker rule: extras list total must not exceed it).

reads.entity: Offer (derived per ticket from wish + catalog)

fields.name: why
fields.note: e.g. 'Holds 6 photos. You have 8.', 'Comes with a starter style. X is premium.', 'Too many extras for a Keepsake.'

reads.note: Computed in the client (lib/maker.ts:420-439) from wish.photos.length, tierOfStyle(wish.style), ticket price. Eligibility and total are price-bearing logic that must be server-authoritative.

usage(loadPro(), planOf(account, loadPro())) from lib/pro-data.ts:103; shown as '<left> left this month' or '<pack> left in your wish pack'. Plan comes from account.pro.plan (starter|studio|pack). Business wish shown as 'A Signature wish. It counts as one'.

actions.name: saveDraft

payload.name: patch
payload.type: Partial<Wish> (whole Wish object is written today via saveWish/putWish, lib/maker.ts:40-46)

actions.note: Fired on every change: typing is debounced 300ms (Maker.tsx:65), choices save immediately (set(...,true)); also on pagehide/visibilitychange. Returns false (UI shows 'Not saved: no room left') when localStorage full.

actions.name: chooseTicket
actions.note: radio tap, saved at once; screen auto-sets ticket=suggest(wish) on entry when empty (Maker.tsx:174).

actions.name: payAndSeal

payload.name: adds
payload.type: string[] extra names e.g. 'A premium style','Five more photos' (derived, not sent today)

payload.name: content
payload.type: WishContent with note.from and finale.sign finalised (noteFrom, finaleOf)

actions.note: Today: PaySheet onPaid() after a 700ms timeout calls sealed(): status='sealed', no=wishNo() (client random 4 digits), step=5, ticket, opensAt, content, reasons. Server must charge (Paystack, Idempotency-Key), issue wish number, and set status sealed atomically.

actions.name: sealOnPlan
actions.note: business: addWish(data, plan, ...) lib/pro-data.ts:123 records a client wish against the monthly allowance or wish pack (returns null if none left -> setFull(true)), then sealed(done.wish.no,'signature') sets Wish status sealed with ticket 'signature' and the ClientWish's no (starts 0901 + max).

rolesObserved: person (owner of the wish); business side when account.pro and (space=='business' or kind teams|photographers)
authContext.note: Maker.tsx:181 renders a blank busy shell if no account; no redirect inside the maker.

special.note: Payment is a provider handoff (PaySheet); receipt 'at once' per copy, nothing implemented.

uiStatesHandled.note: account and draft come from synchronous localStorage read in an effect; one frame at most. With a server read it becomes real and needs the app skeleton.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: ?id= names a wish not in account.wishes or status 'removed' (setMissing, Maker.tsx:90,182-189): 'That wish is not here.'
uiStatesHandled.note: deleted, or made on another device (copy says so; with a server the other-device case disappears)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: saveWish returns false (localStorage quota) -> header text 'Not saved: no room left', Maker.tsx:57,439
uiStatesHandled.note: device-storage error; server equivalent is a failed save with retry. No retry control coded.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: none coded (no network calls on this screen)
not applicable: a draft always has screens
wish, screen and play all present
offer(wish,t).ok false (photos over cap, style tier above Moment, extras over ceiling): button disabled, reason shown
Continue pressed: setPay(true) -> PaySheet (card/transfer/ussd radios, 'Confirming' while busy)
none coded: PaySheet has no failure branch, onPaid always called after 700ms
uiStatesHandled.note: designed error state unreachable; needs declined/failed payment, retry

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: biz && !usage.canMake: 'No wishes left this month.' + link to /app/pro/plan

stubsObserved.evidence: /* A draft is a Wish in the account, saved on every step */ saveWish writes whole account JSON to localStorage 'fw-account'
stubsObserved.consequence: drafts exist only in this browser; ?id= link fails on another device (the 'missing' state)

stubsObserved.standsInFor: server storage of wedding day / opens-now / voice seconds
stubsObserved.consequence: values lost on another device; wedding day and 'now' have no field on Wish

stubsObserved.evidence: const pay = () => { setBusy(true); setTimeout(() => { onPaid(); }, 700); };  /* Nothing is charged here yet */
stubsObserved.consequence: any tap on Pay seals the wish for free; no failure, no transfer account number, no USSD code (STUB-1)

stubsObserved.evidence: wishNo(): String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000)) not in this account
stubsObserved.consequence: numbers collide across accounts and devices (STUB-8)

stubsObserved.standsInFor: a configured promotion with an end date
stubsObserved.consequence: discount and its end are hardcoded; naira price strings parsed from text; prices in catalog.ts are hardcoded (conventions: read from config tables)

stubsObserved.evidence: offer(): eligibility and totals computed in browser
stubsObserved.consequence: client can send any ticket; server must reprice

stubsObserved.evidence: addWish on loadPro() local data; nextNo = max+1 from 900
